0|804627751b4281dd95148e7564759145da67855e|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"xsk: add support for AF_XDP multi-buffer on Rx path
Add multi-buffer support for AF_XDP by extending the XDP multi-buffer
support to be reflected in user-space when a packet is redirected to
an AF_XDP socket.
In the XDP implementation
column2: the NIC driver builds the xdp_buff from the

column1: first frag of the packet and adds any subsequent frags in the skb_shinfo
area of the xdp_buff. In AF_XDP core
xdp_sock's pool and data is copied from the driver's xdp_buff and frags.
Once an allocated XDP buffer is full and there is still data to be
copied
column2: the 'XDP_PKT_CONTD' flag in'options' field of the corresponding

column1: xdp ring descriptor is set and passed to the application. When application
sees the aforementioned flag set it knows there is pending data for this
packet that will be carried in the following descriptors. If there is no
more data to be copied
column2: the flag in 'options' field is cleared for that

column1: descriptor signalling EOP to the application.
If application reads a batch of descriptors using for example the libxdp
interfaces
column2: it is not guaranteed that the batch will end with a full

column1: packet. It might end in the middle of a packet and the rest of the frames
of that packet will arrive at the beginning of the next batch.
AF_XDP ensures that only a complete packet (along with all its frags) is
sent to application.
